message:
Nothing big confirmed locally, so it's DIY school holidays: 18-19C, grey Saturday and a sprinkle of drizzle Sunday. Pack jumpers, snacks and a lot of patience 🧥
Dawesville weekend: 5/10

Dawesville Weekend Assessment

A mild spring weekend ahead: clear and 19 degrees Friday, overcast and 18 Saturday, and a token drizzle at 17 on Sunday. 9 to 5 The Musical closes at ManPAC on Sunday, the Mandurah Arts Festival rolls on, and the Roosters meet the Knights in Sunday's NRL Grand Final. With the kids on holidays, Saturday's Peel Produce Market at the foreshore makes a fine outing, ideally before anyone finds the remote.
Dawesville weekend: 6/10

Dawesville Weekend Assessment

A grey, drizzly weekend awaits, with tops of 15 to 17 degrees and a chilly 10-degree start on Sunday. The Mandurah Arts Festival bows out with free Music Under the Bridge on Saturday evening and the Movers & Makers family day on Sunday morning, while Room on the Broom plays ManPAC on Friday. Pack a raincoat alongside the picnic rug, as the final weekend of the school holidays waits for no one. ☔
Dawesville weekend: 5/10
